card.text: A young planet of about four Jupiter masses on a nearly circular orbit around AF Lep.

sources.label: Balmer et al. 2025
sources.quote: we infer an effectively circular orbit

introduction.text: AF Lep b is the lowest-mass imaged planet whose mass was weighed through its orbit. It circles its star at about 8 au, in line with the star's spin.

sources.label: Franson et al. 2023
sources.quote: AF Lep b is the lowest-mass imaged planet with a dynamical mass measurement

sources.label: Balmer et al. 2025
sources.quote: in spin-orbit alignment with the host

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere of the model radius, glowing with its own heat. No surface, colour or spin is measured.
